messages:
Ian (Sales): quick handoff — Orchid Health signed pilot (6 weeks). Private VPC required, they want KMS/HSM + Okta SAML. Committed 12 seats. Main risks: SSO cert delivery (customer side), CSV schema for data ingest, potential latency sensitivity (customer expects <200ms p95). Uploads start next Tues. Doc: https://redwood.internal/sales/orchid-pilot :wave:
Maya (CS): noted — thx Ian. I'll own activation. Can you drop the provisioning details and the primary contacts at Orchid?
Ian (Sales): Contacts: emma@orchid, raj@orchid (infra). Provisioning notes below. Also they're aiming for initial integration demo week 2 of pilot.
Diego (Support): quick q — will this need Dedicated GPU or can hosted suffice? what's expected qps?
Ian (Sales): expected steady-state ~1.5 qps, spiky up to 5 qps during demos. Model variant: redwood-llama-13b-quant. Likely ok with hosted + burst policy but customer asked about Dedicated pricing.
Hannah (Eng): scheduling architecture sync — can we get network details and KMS/entropy requirements? Also need sample CSV schema for ingestion. Pls attach.
Ian (Sales): CSV schema attached (see link). Network: customer will peer from vpc-prod-orchid, CIDR 10.20.0.0/16. KMS alias customer-kms-009.
onboard-bot: created onboarding checklist PROV-8742 and linked to ticketing system.
Maya (CS): assigning owners and next steps:
- Diego (Support): open infra-access runbook + logging hooks by Fri (PROV-8742).
- Hannah (Eng): 30-min arch sync with Orchid + Raj (customer infra) — propose Thu 11am PT.
- Ian (Sales): get SSO cert and test IdP metadata before Thu.
- Maya (CS): run enablement session with product + docs for end-users in week 1 of pilot.
Diego (Support): ack — will create runbook skeleton and add KV cache dashboard checks. Need confirmation on log retention (customer asked 90d).
Hannah (Eng): ack — Thu 11am works for me. Also need to know if they want KV-cache warmups on demo days.
Ian (Sales): they do. Plan: prewarm 30m before demos.
Maya (CS): noted renewal risk flag — set internal tag: renewal_watch = medium (pilot success tied to latency & integration speed). I'll capture feedback prompts during enablement so we have early sentiment signals.
Diego (Support): +1 on feedback prompts. I'll add a short support survey at day 7 and day 28.
Maya (CS): next steps summary — Diego to create PROV-8742 runbook, Hannah to run arch sync Thu 11am, Ian to upload SSO metadata by Wed EOD, Maya to schedule enablement + feedback cadence. I'll post a follow-up with owners and links after the sync. :thumbsup:
Ian (Sales): thanks all. tagging @Hannah and @Diego to ensure visibility.
Hannah (Eng): thanks — will join Thu.
onboard-bot: reminder set for PROV-8742 on 1781200000 (internal cron).
